description: Retrieve one parameter over ordered latitude/longitude bounds spanning 2–10 degrees per axis, at daily, monthly or climatology resolution. Regional climatology uses the precomputed source period and accepts no year fields; use nasa_power_get_climatology for custom years at a point. Split antimeridian regions into separate calls. Returns cell identities and separate per-period equal-weight cell statistics, not area-weighted estimates. Oversized observations and summaries stage completely with previews, exact counts and SQL handles; query summaryDataset in summaryIndex order.

Declared by this tool: `unsupported_parameter`: A selected code is unavailable for the community and resolution. `invalid_window`: The requested window is reversed or outside source coverage. `invalid_correction`: Correction inputs are unsupported or missing required dependencies. `upstream_rejected`: NASA rejects the scientific request or reference lookup. `upstream_rate_limited`: NASA rate limits a request or shared reference lookup. `request_queue_full`: Source scheduling capacity is exhausted. `canvas_required`: Oversized observations or summaries require an enabled workspace. `canvas_not_found`: The supplied canvas token is absent or expired. `producer_capacity_exhausted`: Other data calls hold the in-flight capacity this call needs past its admission wait. `canvas_capacity_exhausted`: Canvas count, table or retained staging capacity is exhausted. `canvas_busy`: Another query, staging or removal occupies the supplied canvas. `invalid_region`: Regional axes are reversed or span outside 2–10 degrees. `dataset_limit`: The complete native-grid dataset exceeds workload bounds. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
